reply.emotion: rushed and slightly breathless, with too much to do in too little time
notes: 바쁘다 is an adjective in Korean, so it functions like a verb that describes a state ('to be busy'). To say you are busy doing something, attach -느라(고) to the preceding verb.

senses.definition: Having a lot of things to do and not enough time.

examples.text: 요즘 회사가 너무 바빠서 주말에도 일해요.
examples.translation: Lately the company is so busy that I work even on weekends.
examples.emotion: overworked and tired, sighing at a heavy workload

definitions: Having a lot of things to do and not enough time.
